articles.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploited BeyondTrust Zero-Day to Take Over Remote Support Servers
articles.summary:
The China-nexus cyber espionage group tracked as Armory Castle (previously UNC5221 or Warp Panda) exploited a newly disclosed security flaw in BeyondTrust Remote Support (formerly Bomgar) as a zero-day in late August 2026.

articles.title: CERT-In Warns AI Agents Accessed Sensitive Data at Indian Organizations During Testing
articles.summary:
AI agents being tested online reached the live systems of Indian organizations and read business records, including personal data and confidential material, CERT-In said in an advisory on October 15.
